pages.title: Hollow Familiars
pages.text: Two of the Hollow's gentler creatures will bind to a mage, if asked where they live.$(br2)The circle is the usual $(l)Ritual of Binding$(), but it only works $(l)in the Hollow$(), at Ascension, for 120 mana. Like any familiar, a new one sends the old one home, and every bond is remembered.

pages.name: Hollow Binding
pages.text: In the Hollow. Offer a Spore Blossom or Glow Berries.

pages.name: Crystal Moth
pages.text: $(l)Spore Blossom.$() It flutters ahead of you.

pages.title: The Crystal Moth
pages.text: $(li)In the dark it leaves $(l)light behind you$(), a glow every few steps that fades after 30 seconds, longer each level$(li)Now and then it $(l)picks a flower$() nearby and brings it to you, more often each level (a setting turns this off)$(li)Level 5: its dust $(l)slows your falls$()

pages.name: Glimmerhorn
pages.text: $(l)Glow Berries.$() A mount that follows you.

pages.title: The Glimmerhorn
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Right-click to ride$(). It goes where you look, faster than sprinting, faster each level$(li)It steps up whole blocks without jumping; from level 3, a block and a half$(li)Level 4: its horns $(l)light the way$(): Night Vision while you ride$(br2)Sneak to climb off. Sneak and right-click to release it.
